rules: Five dropdowns in the PO form's General Details: Form Type (= the event's RFQ template, locked), Unit Name (= the PR line's location, or the user's teams' units), Legal Entity (depends on Unit Name), Department, Nature of Expense. Sanction Note and Comments are text only and never route.

Only Bid Proposal workflows whose team includes the initiator with the stated role (Member/Manager/Admin) are considered; if any TEAM workflow matches, COMPANY workflows are ignored. Each condition: 'is any of' (OR within the field); all conditions must hold (AND); a field without a condition means any value. Total Proposal Value and the other old conditions combine the same way.

One match → attached. Several → the buyer picks. None → 2017 and no submit (never reachable on DLF UAT while the three company 'test' catch-alls exist). Mandatory fields empty → 2016 'Please fill …'. Chosen workflow no longer matching → 523 'Invalid Approval' and the modal reloads.
General Details read-only; the approval request keeps meta_data.data.routing (values, workflow, rule, match_count, user_selected). Rejection → a new draft with the same values.

Form Type: trade templates; Unit Name: buyer hubs (34 on UAT, incl. junk ones); Legal Entity, Department, Nature of Expense: widget data mapping rows gd_legal_entity / gd_department / gd_nature_of_expense, nesting through pc:unit_name. The builder's condition values come from approval_conditions filled by a sync script.
